target_customer: Small and medium businesses in India and emerging markets managing data, workflows and teams on mobile
problem: SMBs run on paper registers and rigid spreadsheets and need a mobile-first, local language, no-code workspace.
business_model: Freemium B2B SaaS app, monetization not described in sources opened

founders.name: Abhishek Choudhary
previous_startups: Foodmonk (per Inc42 style profile; unverified, outcome unknown)
founders.background_notes: YC bio: Building for SMBs in emerging markets, passionate about SaaS and marketplaces, from IIT Kanpur.

founders.name: Robbin Singh
founders.background_notes: Called co-founder and CTO by YesPress (https://yespress.io/recordbook-yc-w22) and Inc42 people profile (https://inc42.com/company/recordbook/people/); not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Khatabook
competitors.what: Digital ledger and bookkeeping app for Indian merchants
competitors.funding_then: $100M Series C led by Tribe Capital and Moore Strategic Ventures, Aug 2021

competitors.name: Airtable
competitors.what: Spreadsheet database that RecordBook's one-liner uses as its comparison

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile spreadsheet and workflow app with 18 to 30 column types and collaboration is standard mobile engineering; offline sync and local language support add some difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Similar ledger and no-code apps were already funded in India and Airtable could be copied on mobile; no data or network effect is shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; the company remains listed active with 15 people.

market_need_then: Khatabook raised $100M in August 2021 for a similar SMB audience in India, indicating demand; company claims 400 million SMBs globally (one-liner).

branding.domain_note: Site listed in the directory is a Google Play listing, so no primary web domain was evidenced; Android package id still uses foodmonk.

rebrands.why: Not explained; appears in profile and Play Store package names, relationship uncertain

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive name shared with other products; no press on the brand found.

outcome_analysis: RecordBook is an active Bengaluru company from YC W22 with 15 staff, pitched as Airtable for SMBs, entering a space with a well funded rival in Khatabook. Funding is not reliably documented, and no outcome news was found, so the company's trajectory beyond staying small and active cannot be assessed.
notes: Funding unverified: Inc42 reports $1.6M across 2 rounds with a pre-seed led by India Quotient on 14 March 2022; CB Insights says $800K; TheCompanyCheck $460K. Seedtable lists a March 2022 seed. These are aggregators, so no rounds recorded. Aggregators also name Robbin Singh as co-founder and CTO, but no YC or company source opened says so, so he is not listed. Foodmonk link comes from an aggregator profile. Site could not be checked because the listed website is a Play Store page. OkCredit is a likely rival but no dated source for it was found. Completeness pass: the pre-seed of 1.6M USD on 2022-03-14 is recorded from Inc42 alone (a database outlet); Seedtable lists a March 2022 seed, CB Insights says 800K total, TheCompanyCheck 460K, YesPress adds Y Combinator and IQ Capital. Figures conflict, so the amount is unresolved. Robbin Singh is now listed as co-founder and CTO per YesPress and Inc42 profiles.
